identity.description: An attacker downloads a remote MSI file and executes it using msiexec, which triggers the Cortex alert for uncommon msiexec execution from a remote location. The behavior is detected by monitoring for msiexec process start with remote file execution.

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Uncommon msiexec remote execution
biocs.description: Detection of msiexec process starting with a remote file path
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'msiexec.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'http://'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'explorer.exe'

abiocs.name: msiexec remote file execution pattern
abiocs.description: Detects msiexec executing a remote file, which is an uncommon behavior for typical user sessions
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'msiexec.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'http://'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'explorer.exe'
| filter not action_file_path contains 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\'
abiocs.causality_anchor: msiexec.exe process start with remote file

xql_queries.name: msiexec remote execution hunt
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'msiexec.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'http://'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'explorer.exe'
| comp count() by action_file_path, causality_actor_process_image_name
